title: DeepSeek Announces Recent Increase in API Service Prices, Specific Plans to Be Disclosed Separately

content_html:
DeepSeek announced today that it plans to significantly increase the pricing of its DeepSeek API services in the near future. Users are advised to make reasonable arrangements for their usage plans in advance. The specific adjustment plan will be subject to the official notice.

This price adjustment will affect developers and enterprise users who call DeepSeek models through APIs. Currently, DeepSeek has rapidly gained popularity in the domestic and international developer market due to its low model calling costs and strong reasoning capabilities, attracting many enterprises to integrate its models into application development, intelligent customer service, code generation, and other business scenarios.

Industry insiders believe that as the competition in large models gradually shifts from technical capability to commercial operations, AI model service prices are entering a period of dynamic adjustment. Previously, DeepSeek promoted model ecosystem expansion with a high-cost-performance API strategy. This price adjustment may indicate that it is now beginning to further balance computing costs, service scale, and commercial revenue.

In recent years, large model providers have continuously optimized their pricing systems, offering different model versions, calling methods, and service levels to meet the diverse needs of developers and enterprises. The specific adjustment amount and implementation time of DeepSeek's price adjustment still need to be confirmed by the official announcement.

content_html_zh:
DeepSeek 今天宣布，计划在不久的将来大幅提高其 DeepSeek API 服务的定价。 建议用户提前合理安排自己的使用计划。 具体调整方案以官方通知为准。

此次价格调整将影响通过API调用DeepSeek模型的开发者和企业用户。 目前，DeepSeek凭借低廉的模型调用成本和强大的推理能力，迅速在国内外开发者市场受到欢迎，吸引众多企业将其模型融入到应用开发、智能客服、代码生成等业务场景中。

业内人士认为，随着大模型的竞争逐渐从技术能力转向商业运营，AI模型服务价格正在进入动态调整期。 此前，DeepSeek以高性价比的API策略推动模型生态扩张。 这次价格调整可能表明它现在开始进一步平衡计算成本、服务规模和商业收入。

近年来，大型模型提供商不断优化其定价体系，提供不同的模型版本、调用方式和服务级别，以满足开发者和企业的多样化需求。 DeepSeek调价的具体调整金额和实施时间仍需以官方公告确认。
